svg.title: Spectrograms, 48 kHz clip low-passed at 8 kHz
svg.desc: Three spectrograms of the same synthetic voice clip: the wideband original, the same clip low-passed at 8 kHz, and the low-passed clip after processing, which fills the empty band above the detected cutoff.
